name: Night Owl
description:
Night-mode loudness normalizer for your current audio output.

Tames sudden loud moments — explosions, gunshots, ad breaks — while lifting quiet dialogue, so you can watch films at night without waking the house. Audio is routed through a PipeWire filter chain (SC4 compressor into a lookahead limiter) that guarantees a hard output ceiling.

Toggle it from Quick Settings. Three presets: Gentle, Movie Night and Late Night. Requires the LADSPA swh-plugins package.
